text: In this month we converged. On May 4, 2017, 184 of us said "american health care act," and 179 said "the american health care act." The first of us to say it, R000570, had begun on 2017-02-27; B000755 followed on 2017-03-06. 108 of us said "with pre-existing conditions," a phrase whose record predates us, first dated 2013-01-31 to Tammy Baldwin. 65 of us said "repeal and replace," first dated 2013-04-25. 63 of us said "of the american health care act," 63 said "american health care act ahca," and 61 said "the american health care act ahca," these two first dated 2017-03-07 to Andy Harris. 61 of us said "health care system." We record that on a single day, May 4, our phrasing peaked together. This was the shape of the month: one act, named and renamed, repeated by us in near-unison.
